name: GRE 高频词
detailText: 精选开源 GRE 高频词 starter（非完整红宝书，可导入 .apkg 扩充）。

cards.sentence: Social media fame can be ephemeral.
cards.back:
ephemeral / 短暂的

 lasting a very short time；GRE 高频形容词。

cards.sentence: Politicians often equivocate when asked direct questions.
cards.back:
equivocate / 含糊其辞

故意说模棱两可的话以回避立场。

cards.sentence: His laconic reply ended the conversation.
cards.back:
laconic / 简洁的、惜字如金的

用很少的词表达意思。

cards.sentence: The prodigal spending left the company nearly bankrupt.
cards.back:
prodigal / 挥霍的

浪费资源或金钱；the prodigal son 败家子典故。

cards.sentence: Trees can mitigate the effects of urban heat islands.
cards.front: Trees can ______ the effects of urban heat islands.
cards.back:
mitigate

mitigate / 减轻、缓解

使坏事的影响变小。

cards.sentence: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.
cards.back:
ubiquitous / 无处不在的

seeming to be everywhere at once。

cards.sentence: She took a pragmatic approach to solving the budget crisis.
cards.back:
pragmatic / 务实的

重实际效果而非理论或理想。

cards.sentence: Remove any superfluous details from your essay.
cards.back:
superfluous / 多余的

超出所需；GRE 写作可用于精简论证。

cards.sentence: A benevolent donor funded the new library.
cards.back:
benevolent / 仁慈的、乐善好施的

对比 malevolent（恶意的）。

cards.sentence: The capricious weather made planning difficult.
cards.back:
capricious / 反复无常的

变化莫测、难以预测。

cards.sentence: Diligent preparation is essential for a high GRE score.
cards.back:
diligent / 勤奋的

steady and careful effort。

cards.sentence: The humid heat enervated the hikers within an hour.
cards.back:
enervate / 使衰弱

 drain energy or strength；易与 energize 混淆。

cards.sentence: She is fastidious about grammar and punctuation.
cards.back:
fastidious / 挑剔的、一丝不苟的

very attentive to accuracy and detail。

cards.sentence: The garrulous tour guide talked throughout the entire bus ride.
cards.back:
garrulous / 话多的

 excessively talkative。

cards.sentence: As an iconoclast, she challenged established theories in her field.
cards.back:
iconoclast / 反传统者

攻击或否定普遍信念的人。

cards.sentence: The film juxtaposes wealth and poverty in the same city.
cards.back:
juxtapose / 并置、对照

把 contrasting 事物放在一起以突出差异。

cards.sentence: Her laudable efforts improved literacy rates in the region.
cards.back:
laudable / 值得赞扬的

 deserving praise and commendation。

cards.sentence: Meticulous note-taking helped him retain new vocabulary.
cards.back:
meticulous / 一丝不苟的

 showing great attention to detail。

cards.sentence: Some argue that memorising word lists is obsolete in the AI era.
cards.back:
obsolete / 过时的

 no longer produced or used。

cards.sentence: Recalcitrant members blocked every compromise.
cards.back:
recalcitrant / 顽固抗命的

 stubbornly resistant to authority。
